g.text: Raw motor command · the StepperMotor worker path
Raw action acceptance precedes launching the motor worker.
A later launch failure produces Faulted, not a successful move.
Current raw completion reports a command result before the
worker necessarily returns. Ordinary completion does not join it.
The sequential robot-homing path explicitly calls stopAndWait().
Other raw motors may run independently; same-motor buffering retains ownership.
Raw motor stop is immediate cessation, not the Executor's coordinated brake.
A raw stop targeting a robot-owned member aborts its whole group.
Existing motor commands bypass Robot/Planner and the coordinated Executor program path.
This diagram describes current source behavior. Action acceptance and successful execution are distinct events.
